{{Quote|This is a matter of Corellian planetary security. All shipping orders require the approval of my Transport Commission. Given the intensely competitive nature of the Corellian engineering industry, I prefer to render such procedures invulnerable to surveillance by rival corporations.|[[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]]|<ref name="SWG:DG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Daclif Gallamby|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Transport Commission''' was an organization of the [[Corellian republic|Corellian government]] charged with overseeing contracts for the sale of [[Transport/Legends|space transports]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:DG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Transport Commission agent [[Merlyx Dolv]] discovered an illegal contract between the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] and the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] arranged by [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]], the Corellian head of state.<ref name="SWG:DG" />
